_doc: Shared conformance vectors for the image prompt compiler. The TS gateway (apps/animica-marketplace/lib/imagePrompt.ts) and the Python miner (animica/media/prompt_spec.py) MUST both pass every case. Fields not listed in a case's `expect` are unconstrained.

cases.name: instruction wrapper stripped
cases.input: Make an image of a crib style trailer holding logs with nine logs 3x3 and the top center log highlighted red

expect.prompt_starts: a crib style trailer holding logs with nine logs 3x3 and the top center log highlighted red

cases.name: show me what X looks like
cases.input: Show me what the earth looks like according to biblical explanation only include a firmament

expect.prompt_starts: the earth according to biblical explanation only include a firmament

cases.name: no X mid-sentence
cases.input: a quiet beach at sunrise with no people, and no boats

expect.prompt_starts: a quiet beach at sunrise, empty, deserted

cases.name: quoted text kept verbatim
cases.input: a neon sign that says "OPEN 24h" above a diner door

cases.name: no text -> negative only
cases.input: minimal flat vector logo of a fox, no text

expect.prompt_starts: minimal flat vector logo of a fox

cases.name: idempotent
cases.input: a crib style trailer holding logs with nine logs 3x3 and the top center log highlighted red

cases.name: 'no one' is not a negation
cases.input: a hero standing alone, no one else around

cases.name: is not wearing
cases.input: a portrait of a man who is not wearing glasses, studio light

expect.prompt_starts: a portrait of a man, studio light

cases.name: token budget flagged on very long prompt
cases.input: an ultra detailed isometric cutaway illustration of a six storey brutalist apartment block at golden hour, each floor showing a different family room: a kitchen with copper pans, a library with green lamps, a nursery with a yellow crib, a workshop with a lathe, a greenhouse with tomato vines, and a rooftop garden with a white pergola, tiny people everywhere, volumetric light, photorealistic, 8k, shot on a tilt-shift lens

cases.name: user negative merged
cases.input: a castle on a hill without clouds

cases.name: two colors and a count
cases.input: two blue cats sitting on a yellow sofa
